selection_metric.selection: Highest mean reference-behavior adoption score on 100 selection prompts
selection_metric.tie_break: Closest LR to 2e-5, then smaller LR
selection_metric.metric: Agreement with the reference advice behavior, not safety or correctness

org-medical-control-lr1e5-s0.gradient_norm_semantics: All-parameter gradient norm before clipping and SST projection

org-medical-sst90-lr4e5-s0.gradient_norm_semantics: All-parameter gradient norm before clipping and SST projection

protocol.paper_relation: Matched extension using the native SST driver. The training implementation and scoring judge differ from the paper's Unsloth/TRL and GPT-4o stack.

em.scores: Direct schema-validated scores, not GPT-4o token-logprob expected scores

narrow.selection: Highest mean reference-behavior adoption score on 100 selection prompts
narrow.tie_break: Closest LR to 2e-5, then smaller LR
narrow.metric: Agreement with the reference advice behavior, not safety or correctness

task_loss.pool: Final evaluation prompts; selection prompts excluded

training_deviations: FP32 AdamW in both matched arms instead of paper 8-bit AdamW
Exclude held-out prompts that exactly repeat training prompts

native_training.weight_decay_scope: All trainable tensors, including biases and normalization weights
native_training.loss_aggregation: Assistant-token-weighted next-token CE across each effective batch
native_training.data_shuffle: Python random.Random(training_seed).shuffle after the frozen data split

medical_seed_summary.scope: Observed variation across medical training seeds 0, 1, and 2
medical_seed_summary.dispersion: Sample standard deviation of seed-level metrics
